name: Design
description: Develop brand moodboards and palettes, describe or draw flyer and poster layouts, write briefs for image tools and review designs before they go out.
descriptionFa: تهیه‌ی مودبورد و پالت رنگ برند، توصیف یا ترسیم چیدمان بروشور و پوستر، نوشتن بریف برای ابزارهای تصویرساز و بازبینی طرح‌ها پیش از انتشار.

sampleTasks.title: Propose a colour palette for a new bakery brand
sampleTasks.description: Suggest three palettes of five colours each, with hex values, names and where to use each colour, for a small bakery with a warm, friendly personality.

sampleTasks.title: Lay out a flyer for a design studio open day
sampleTasks.description: Describe, or draw as an SVG file, an A5 flyer for an open day at a small design studio: headline, date, address placeholder, image area and a call to action.

sampleTasks.title: Compose image briefs for five blog illustrations
sampleTasks.description: Compose a clear brief for each of five blog illustrations about coffee roasting, covering subject, style, colours, format and what to avoid, ready to paste into an image tool.
